title: Workers lists this machine and an added host with cores, temperature, steal and runs now, and an unreachable host as away
description: The added host is a fixture prepared by running the script `graphyard host prepare` prints: dedicated unprivileged gy-compute user, rootless Docker on its own socket, key restricted to the forced-command graphyard-host-shim, not in the docker group. `host add` accepts it through the shim and refuses an unrestricted key, a root target and a docker-group user. Each loop cycle reads this machine and every added host (cores, hottest CPU sensor, steal, trial containers running now); /api/status serves them and the Workers page lists them in a Hosts table, this machine first; a host that does not answer reads Away with its reason. At 1280 px and 390 px.

steps.name: the prepared host: the script host prepare prints, run, leaves gy-compute with rootless Docker and a shim-only key; host add refuses an unrestricted key, root and a docker-group user
host add records the prepared host and writes nothing on it; one without Docker or unreachable is refused with a plain reason
the host list on the served Workers page, read from the prepared fixture through its shim
